reviews.comment: Great professor. It's pretty easy to get lost in lectures because he dives really deep into concepts, gets abstract, and moves at a fast pace. He's a really caring guy. I do wish this class were less proof-based, since most of the students are engineers who won't need proofs in their careers.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a very caring professor and good at communicating non-lecture related content. His lectures are pretty good too, though sometimes it gets too abstract to follow along. Going to his office hours had been the most helpful for me to learn and get homework done. Again, he's one of the profs that actually cares about teaching. Amazing!

Probably one of the best professors to take for 311. He takes very abstract problems and breaks them down easily into ways that students can understand. HW wasn't the worst either, you can attend his office hours, he is very helpful and easy-going. He made me actually enjoy linear algebra and develop an interest in mathematical proofs.
Absolute Goat, incerdibly helpful and patient in office hours
Goat. Take him
A very fast paced and monotonously abstract class.

this was the first math class i struggled in, esp with the HW and tests because i swear he didnt teach ts in lecture. my fav part was that attendance wasnt mandatory so i stopped going to class but the online notes are also so hard to read. i only got an A because he made the final easy but maybe thats just me cuz the average was a 75

This professor is competent. He does assign a lot of homework but that homework prepares you well for the exams and they're not that bad to do. This is because homework practice makes perfect! He teaches well, and you'll learn a lot in this very fast-paced course. All lectures are understandable but whatever you do, DON'T FALL BEHIND.

Okay, he gives good lectures but I never went to them tbh bc they were pretty boring. His tests are doable if you actually went and paid attention unlike me, otherwise you will struggle. I got quite lucky tbh to end up with an A. His homework is the most abhorrent thing I have ever seen, please do not take him for that alone.
He was a great 311 prof. Although he was very new when I had him, his lectures were useful, and he was super helpful. Very chill guy, and tests were not too bad (but make up about 90% of your grade).
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing Professor who you can tell is really passionate about teaching. I would say though, the exams are pretty difficult, however does he provide exam reviews with relatively same difficulty as the exams along with a curve after each exam. If you can handle fast paced teaching then you will do just fine in this class.

He's very smart and passionate about teaching. GO TO CLASS AND WRITE NOTES! This class is fast paced so try to study every week.There are conceptional questions in the exams so you must deeply understand the topics. Prof grades very generously and curved in both exams. Never leave your paper empty, even if you don't know the answer (partial credit)
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Good lecturer but his exams are significantly harder than the other 311 profs. However, he does explain the concepts in great detail, but if you zone out even for a little, you'll probably get lost. Puts a bigger emphasis on proofs for homework and exams, but a cheat sheet is allowed, so it isn't too bad. Overall, solid choice or 311.

Awesome professor who makes even the most complex portions of the class understandable. The material can be pretty difficult, so paying attention in lectures is necessary. He teaches in a manner that makes it much harder than other 311 professors, but getting an A is still very achievable, and you leave a more in-depth understanding of the material
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very solid pick for 311, it's a hard class by nature but he is a good enough lecturer and nice guy. Also allows a cheat sheet on the exam which is much more helpful on the exam than any other class that has allowed cheat sheets
It was his first time teaching here and he had a bit of trouble getting the tests right for time limit, other than that, just do the homeworks and pay attention and it won't be too difficult.

Dr. Siktar is new but did his best with the resources and feedback given to him. By the end of the course, he had the exams figured out and they were very reasonable as long as you go to class and do your homework and practice exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: New professor; he did a good job. He's a solid lecturer, worked through his notes on a whiteboard. His notes were very helpful in understanding the material. He struggled at first to balance exam length and difficulty, but was very receptive to feedback and will improve over time. Prepare well for exams, as they are 80% of your grade once again.

Reads off of his lecture notes for class but mostly helpful for understanding. Would advise going to HOGU and WIR Sessions for understanding. He's a new prof who was stil trying to get the hang of things, but is very open to feedback. He is caring and wants his students to succeed. 251 is also just a hard class, but he is a good option for it.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Siktar is a very nice, young prof who definitely will improve over time. The tests were more difficult than 151 and 152, but he should improve this given time. He's a smart guy but his teaching style wasn't for me. He taught to the board and mostly just re-wrote the definitions from the notes with minimal practice problems. Learned mostly from HOGU

Exam-heavy class (80%) with weekly homework and quizzes- doesn't matter which prof you get. He is a nice guy that explains topics clearly and cares about his students. Explains difficult topics clearly and does many examples to help you understand. His exam writing can vary in difficulty since he is new, so given time, the tests will be better.
Really just a great prof overall. The class is exam heavy, but that's not up to him. He has great lectures. He speaks very clearly and explains the material well.
Very susceptible to feedback and cares about covering all of the material. Lots of homework, but very helpful for understanding. In person notes are very helpful for exams.

Not a bad professor overall, currently a new professor and is figuring things out. There's a lot of homework but deadlines are very flexible. The exams for this class are questionable, the first exam was way too long, the second exam was a lot more more reasonable,  and the third exam in between, however, final replaces your lowest exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: New professor but his notes are good for doing the homework, still working out how to make tests short enough/hard enough. Really helpful if you reach out outside of class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class
